topography.project_purpose: Onchain Capital Allocator. Structurally: 34 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc721holder, erc20permit, eip712). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
